description: This file defines the Address controller class within the OpenCart admin module for handling customer address management. It includes methods for listing, editing, and saving customer addresses, along with form handling and validation logic.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer addresses within the OpenCart administration panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the default address listing page for a customer, setting up the data and returning the view.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the list of addresses for a specific customer.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the address form for adding or editing a customer address.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of address data, either adding a new address or updating an existing one.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer address based on provided address ID, with permission checks.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Displays a specific customer address details, allowing editing.
